abstract.t: A COSE Hash Envelope signs the digest of a preimage, not the preimage itself. When the preimage is the encoding of a structured value, such as a CBOR data item, and a verifier holds that value but not the bytes that were hashed, the verifier has to encode the value again, and the digest matches only if it applies the same deterministic encoding as the producer. CBOR permits more than one encoding of the same data item, and the preimage content type does not identify the encoding that was applied. This document defines a COSE Hash Envelope protected-header parameter that identifies the encoding: the integer 1 for the Core Deterministic Encoding Requirements of RFC 8949, or a URL for any other encoding, named by the application profile that uses the parameter. A verifier ignores a value that does not identify an encoding it implements.
